svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Recommendations, round 1
svg.desc: Concept 10 Coupon Book. Recommendations workspace for round 1 of the plan Spring re-slot 2026: rows per rule with reasons in numbers, Apply / Apply with another location / Keep in place, applied, kept, outdated (VOID) and no-space states, plus a round route map and the before/after effect.
